question: How does the Shiva-nature of all states affect the reality of bondage and liberation?
premises: All states are of the nature of Śiva.
Bondage and liberation are considered as a pair.
If all is Śiva, their independent existence is negated.
inference: Because all states are Śiva, bondage and liberation do not ultimately exist.
plain_english: Because all states are of the nature of Śiva, there is no existence of bondage and liberation.
